_comment: Frame-level source of truth. Total runtime 156.0 seconds at 24fps. All text in `post` is composited after motion generation.

shots.purpose: Establish physical film grammar before any image.
shots.action: Black leader with restrained projector chatter; two small dust marks only.
shots.audio: Projector chatter begins; no music.
shots.risk: Over-damaging the leader reads as VHS parody.
shots.approval_gate: Maximum two visible dust events.

shots.purpose: Identify the aggressively mundane institution.
shots.action: Cream optical title; red pencil checks AUTHORIZED FOR INTERNAL OCCURRENCE.
shots.audio: Three-note educational chime.
shots.intentional_error: Checkbox is marked before the module occurs.
shots.risk: Generated handwriting or malformed pencil fingers.
shots.approval_gate: Use a practical or separately generated hand; typography cannot be generated.

shots.purpose: Lock training-room geography for the ending.
shots.action: Empty training room; red binder on lectern; three labeled drawers rear-left.
shots.camera: Static 28mm master, 1.45m height, centered on lectern.
shots.audio: Fluorescent ballast and projector room tone.
shots.risk: Unmotivated camera creep.
shots.approval_gate: Tripod remains pixel-stable apart from film weave added later.

shots.purpose: Foreshadow the single case moving through all three categories.
shots.action: A red case slip travels mechanically through PROPERTY, then EVENT, then PERSON routing trays.
shots.camera: Three matched 2-second 65mm inserts; tray labels remain fixed.
shots.audio: Paper slide, routing bell, steel drawer catch; same rhythm three times.
shots.intentional_error: PERSON tray bell sounds before the slip arrives.
shots.risk: Generated labels or changing slip geometry.
shots.approval_gate: One practical slip is reused; all labels are post composites.

shots.purpose: Introduce Mara and Case 4-19 without exposition staging.
shots.action: Mara enters behind right shoulder, crosses to lectern, opens red binder to Case 4-19.
shots.audio: Measured footsteps, binder rings.
shots.risk: Long hand interaction and facial drift.
shots.approval_gate: Cut before page lies flat; binder interior replaced in post.

shots.purpose: Establish June's desk as mug-free.
shots.action: June works at payroll desk; right-hand mug position visibly empty.
shots.camera: Locked 40mm master, shallow three-quarter desk angle.
shots.audio: Office HVAC, paper, distant telephone.
shots.risk: Model adds generic desk clutter where mug must appear.
shots.approval_gate: Immutable clean plate with protected empty region.

shots.purpose: Reveal mug through continuity, not morphing.
shots.action: Cut tighter: approved cobalt-striped mug is already under June's reaching hand; steam rises.
shots.camera: Locked 65mm insert matching P01 desk geometry.
shots.audio: Ceramic resonance before hand touches mug.
shots.intentional_error: Mug exists between cuts.
shots.risk: Rubber fingers or altered mug markings.
shots.approval_gate: Mug identity exact; hand never closes around handle.

shots.purpose: Show Department procedure and preserve object state.
shots.action: Mara lowers a glass evidence dome around mug without touching it.
shots.camera: Static 40mm side medium; Mara frame-left, June frame-right.
shots.audio: Glass base contacts desk; room tone ducks.
shots.risk: Transparent glass, hands and two faces in one generation.
shots.approval_gate: Generate stable base performance and composite dome separately.

shots.purpose: Give Mara one human observation without melodrama.
shots.action: Mara studies condensation inside dome and says: It's warm.
shots.camera: Locked 65mm Mara single; dome edge foreground.
shots.audio: One sync line; fluorescent room tone.
shots.risk: Overperformed concern or weak lip sync.
shots.approval_gate: One short line only; expression remains technical.

shots.purpose: Make contradiction legible through two records.
shots.action: Receipt identifies JUNE HAVEL / CAFETERIA / THURSDAY 14 / 08:43 beside evidence tag observed Monday 11.
shots.audio: Paper slide and pencil annotation.
shots.intentional_error: Observation predates purchase.
shots.risk: Unreadable information at normal viewing size.
shots.approval_gate: Purchaser, location and dates remain legible together for at least 48 frames.

shots.purpose: First visible reality correction.
shots.action: AUTHORITATIVE stamp lands; the purchase date becomes Friday 8 while purchaser, cafeteria and time remain fixed.
shots.audio: Heavy stamp impact; no electronic effect.
shots.intentional_error: A document revises its own date.
shots.risk: More than the date changes, weakening the authority of the record.
shots.approval_gate: Only date changes; no flash, glow, glitch or paper movement.

shots.purpose: Reveal the cost of repairing the receipt.
shots.action: Clinical photograph of June admitted Friday 8. Mara slides revised cafeteria receipt across the lower half of the photograph.
shots.audio: Hospital fluorescent tone leaks under office bed.
shots.intentional_error: Mug appears small in photograph corner.
shots.risk: Audience misses hospital-date conflict.
shots.approval_gate: Receipt proves June was placed in cafeteria during recorded admission.

shots.purpose: Transfer contradiction into Peter and launch linked case.
shots.action: While receipt fully occludes patient region, switch states. As it clears, patient card reads Peter Gray and Peter occupies the bed; pillow indentation and room remain identical.
shots.audio: Continuous hospital room tone, paper pass, distant trolley.
shots.intentional_error: Record and image reconcile to Peter.
shots.risk: Visible morphing or changing photograph geometry.
shots.approval_gate: Use two still states; frame, glare and pillow are identical.

shots.purpose: Record Peter's approved normal crossing.
shots.action: Peter crosses deep background right-to-left behind cafeteria couple.
shots.audio: Bicycle bell, seven heels, newspaper snap, cough.
shots.risk: Gait or face changes; screen direction flips.
shots.approval_gate: One approved crossing becomes the only loop source.

shots.purpose: Bridge the first eleven-second interval without exposing loop construction.
shots.action: Couple continue ordinary conversation; neither notices Peter.
shots.camera: Static 65mm foreground two-shot, Peter lane excluded.
shots.audio: Loop cue continues offscreen; dialogue indistinct.
shots.risk: Unnecessary lip detail.
shots.approval_gate: Conversation remains inaudible and natural.

shots.purpose: Complete the exact first interval and cue recurrence.
shots.action: Clock second hand reaches the same mark; green umbrella reflection enters café glass.
shots.audio: Eleven-second musical cell reaches final note.
shots.intentional_error: Clock repeats its prior eleven seconds.
shots.risk: Too much information in insert.
shots.approval_gate: At frame 264 from E01 start, E04 must begin. Clock remains subordinate.

shots.purpose: Prove recurrence beyond subjective similarity.
shots.action: Exact E01 crossing repeats frame-for-frame until the final 18 frames, when Peter stops and turns toward the surveillance lens.
shots.audio: Exact bicycle, heels, snap and cough repeated sample-for-sample.
shots.intentional_error: Time reuses approved background action.
shots.risk: Any difference destroys the premise.
shots.approval_gate: E04 begins exactly +11.000s from E01. Pixel/audio diff is zero before the alternate tail.

shots.purpose: Give Peter one direct human question after awareness is proven.
shots.action: Monitor close-up holds Peter's stopped look. He asks: Where should I have been? Mara's hand approaches intercom.
shots.camera: Static 65mm monitor insert; Mara hand foreground edge.
shots.audio: Peter line filtered through monitor; narrator interrupts before reply.
shots.risk: Lip sync at tiny scale or generated monitor text.
shots.approval_gate: Record line separately; cut before full mouth closure if sync softens.

shots.purpose: Show documentation altering collective memory.
shots.action: Mara enters RECURRING PEDESTRIAN; cut to one cafeteria witness saying he walks here every day.
shots.camera: 65mm keyboard insert, then a single 65mm witness close-up.
shots.audio: Keyboard; one short synchronized line.
shots.intentional_error: Witness memory updates after status entry.
shots.risk: UI legibility and lip sync compete in four seconds.
shots.approval_gate: UI and witness are separate cuts; all text is composited.

shots.purpose: Close event case and carry mug contamination forward.
shots.action: Peter crosses a third time unnoticed. Cobalt mug occupies 4% of frame on couple's table.
shots.camera: E01 master with mug foreground layer.
shots.audio: Crossing motif accepted into street ambience.
shots.intentional_error: Mug migrates into linked case.
shots.risk: Mug looks pasted or is too subtle to read.
shots.approval_gate: Mug occupies 3–5% of frame and obeys table perspective.

shots.purpose: Expose the mechanism that transfers Peter's history to Lina.
shots.action: Peter's status panel updates PERSONNEL LINK: RELEASED. Compatibility search resolves to LINA ORTIZ before she enters.
shots.audio: Card reader, routing bell from T04, badge printer.
shots.intentional_error: Released history is allocated before Lina appears.
shots.risk: Exposition becomes UI-driven.
shots.approval_gate: Show only PERSONNEL LINK: RELEASED and LINA ORTIZ; narration carries policy.

shots.purpose: Make childhood transfer physical before explaining it.
shots.action: Lina enters left-to-right carrying red satchel and wooden airplane as ordinary possessions.
shots.audio: Satchel buckle, fluorescent office bed.
shots.intentional_error: Lina carries Peter's immutable props.
shots.risk: Walking, two props and facial consistency.
shots.approval_gate: Props are attached in approved start frame; cut before Lina sets them down.

shots.purpose: Let recognition precede identity.
shots.action: Peter sees wooden airplane; touches absent eyebrow scar.
shots.audio: Office room tone; small wooden knock.
shots.intentional_error: Peter recognizes an object no longer documented as his.
shots.risk: Hand-to-face motion and scar drift.
shots.approval_gate: Cut before fingertips contact eyebrow; remove scar in approved keyframe.

shots.purpose: Establish family photograph before allocation.
shots.action: Child Peter beside Mrs. Gray; fixed adults, frame glare and paper crease.
shots.audio: Fluorescent buzz; no score.
shots.risk: Audience misses Peter identity.
shots.approval_gate: Child Peter references adult Peter without uncanny face copy.

shots.purpose: Transfer documented childhood with one surgical change.
shots.action: Under fluorescent flicker, child Lina replaces child Peter; all other pixels remain stable.
shots.audio: Ballast click; two musical motifs exchange instruments.
shots.intentional_error: Family evidence now documents Lina.
shots.risk: Changing adults, glare or frame exposes generative edit.
shots.approval_gate: Difference matte contains only the child region.

shots.purpose: Convey bureaucratic violence through physical details.
shots.action: Lina's new scar; allergy card; dog photograph; Peter's empty wallet photo sleeve.
shots.audio: Badge printer, card slide, wallet leather.
shots.intentional_error: Evidence distributes one childhood across two adults.
shots.risk: Montage becomes sentimental or expositional.
shots.approval_gate: No crying, swelling music or explanatory dialogue.

shots.purpose: First half of signature recognition transfer.
shots.action: Mrs. Gray recognizes Peter; Lina waits frame-right.
shots.audio: Refrigerator motor and wall clock only.
shots.risk: Three stable faces in one shot.
shots.approval_gate: Use shallow blocking and restrained motion; if identities drift, build from layered singles.

shots.purpose: Transfer recognition through paperwork rather than magic.
shots.action: Allocation form wipes lens; when it clears, Mrs. Gray recognizes Lina.
shots.camera: Exact I06 lock, full-frame left-to-right practical paper wipe.
shots.audio: One continuous kitchen room-tone take; paper pass.
shots.intentional_error: Recognition follows form state.
shots.risk: Blocking mismatch across wipe.
shots.approval_gate: Background alignment error under 1 pixel; no morph or eye effect.

shots.purpose: Mara states the objection that creates the final personnel discrepancy.
shots.action: Mara closes binder and says: They cannot both be true.
shots.camera: Locked 65mm Mara single, photograph reflection foreground.
shots.audio: Sync line, then narrator response dry and immediate.
shots.risk: Heroic rebellion performance.
shots.approval_gate: Deliver as a technical correction, with no raised voice or tears.

shots.purpose: Show the record absorbing Mara immediately after her objection.
shots.action: Slow push into the family photograph: adult Mara now stands in the back row holding the binder; cobalt mug sits on the school desk.
shots.camera: Mechanical 65mm macro push, 3% scale over six seconds.
shots.audio: Score thins to one sustained harmonium tone.
shots.intentional_error: The record retroactively contains Mara and the originating mug.
shots.risk: Two clues are too obvious or illegible.
shots.approval_gate: First-time silent viewer discovers both Mara and mug in six seconds.

shots.purpose: Reveal the film becoming the authoritative reality.
shots.action: Opening training-room master, now pristine; Mara is already instructor at lectern.
shots.audio: Street, hospital and office room tones now coexist softly.
shots.intentional_error: Mara occupies role not previously shown.
shots.risk: Set mismatch reads as regeneration.
shots.approval_gate: Reuse T03 background pixels; generate and composite only Mara and lectern props.

shots.purpose: Show reassignment through costume and prop continuity.
shots.action: Mara at lectern; cobalt mug at right hand; binder open.
shots.camera: Locked 65mm medium, same axis as T03.
shots.audio: Narrator states personnel correction.
shots.intentional_error: Mug and Mara have been absorbed into instruction.
shots.risk: Mug markings or Mara identity drift.
shots.approval_gate: Approved keyframe carries all identity; motion is breath and eye movement only.

shots.purpose: Make Mara perform the policy that erased her objection.
shots.action: Mara reads: If discrepancies remain after reconciliation, update the employee.
shots.audio: One sync line; no score underneath.
shots.intentional_error: Mara now endorses the correction.
shots.risk: Sinister stare or melodramatic hesitation.
shots.approval_gate: One ordinary breath before line; eyes remain on binder.

shots.purpose: Close administratively while preserving one unresolved state.
shots.action: Certificate shows COMPLETED BY: MARA VOSS and one unchecked box. Mara's left-wrist watch identifies the hand as hers. She refuses to check it. CONTINUITY RESTORED stamp lands across the empty box anyway.
shots.audio: Pen touches paper but does not mark; stamp; clean three-note chime; projector stops.
shots.intentional_error: Institution certifies the unchecked correction.
shots.risk: Hand identity or competing certificate details dilute refusal.
shots.approval_gate: Only employee name and checkbox are readable; hold two seconds after stamp.
